haikus.haiku:
Lemon zest glows bright
Citrus waves splash soft cool air
Sunlit juice sparks joy
Happy #NationalLemonJuiceDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Steaming wok sings bright,
Savory steam curls up gold—
Chopsticks tap with joy.
Happy #NationalChopSueyDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Blue sax sighs at dusk
Melody curls through night air
Stars swirl on velvet
#HappyBirthdayCharlieParker from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft candle bright flicks
Warm soft co‑coa sighs on lips
Joyous laughter rings
#HappyBirthdayIngridBergman from @
